subtitulo: Mi pueblo es igual de bonito que el tuyo.
regla: Igual de + adjective / adverb + que = as … as. Igual de never changes; the adjective agrees. With a plural subject comparing each other, drop que.

bloques.texto: To say two things are equal in some quality, the most common way is [[5116|tan … como]]. Another way is **igual de … que**.
**Igual de** never changes. The adjective agrees with the noun as usual: **igual de altos**, **igual de divertidas**.
When the subject is plural and the things are compared **with each other**, drop **que**: **esos dos gatos son igual de lindos**.
It also works with adverbs: **trabaja igual de duro que sus empleados**.
Tip: **igual** is frozen like a statue; the adjective next to it does all the moving.

lista.es: Mi pueblo es ==igual de bonito que== el tuyo.
lista.en: My town is as pretty as yours.

lista.es: Su hija es ==igual de alta que== Carmen.
lista.en: Her daughter is as tall as Carmen.

lista.es: Los papás de Beto son ==igual de estrictos que== sus abuelos.
lista.en: Beto's parents are as strict as his grandparents.

lista.es: Las fiestas de Rosarito son ==igual de divertidas que== las de Ensenada.
lista.en: Rosarito's parties are as fun as Ensenada's.

lista.es: Esos dos gatos son ==igual de lindos==.
lista.en: Those two cats are just as cute as each other.

lista.es: Mi jefe trabaja ==igual de duro que== nosotros.
lista.en: My boss works as hard as we do.
